body:
CLOSED. The grant ran to its 07:00 mark; its brief is complete now, late.

Overnight dispatch passed to the robotics seat, and this desk filed no 22:45 launch report. That seat's ledger (jobs.csv, sha256 1e3c5e8c..., matches) names every unit with its owner seat, provider and dispatch time: 147 records, 72 cards, 71 checks and 4 registers across 20 seats.

Findings: the 08:52 night review (rpt-sciences-g4-night-process-review-1020) synthesizes them; per-card dispositions are in the g4 Sciences mainline map (sha256 8190f363..., matches).

Owners' working minutes were never instrumented. The nearest measure is the ledger's dispatch-to-first-report time: 2,612 card job-minutes over 590 elapsed minutes (22:23 to 08:13), so 4.4 cards in flight on average, and 7.9 jobs counting checks and registers. Queue and admission waits sit inside those minutes, so this bounds occupancy, not active work.

This filing answers the board stall and receipts the MAINLINE-062 creator copy.

links.what: Grant ran to 07:00; brief now complete from the robotics ledger, the night review and the per-card map. Owners' minutes are ledger dispatch-to-first-report occupancy (4.4 cards in flight), never instrumented working minutes; no 22:45 launch report from this desk.
Stall answered: this report closes the grant order.
Creator-copy receipt only; MAINLINE-062 is dispatched by Robotics and owes nothing here.
